_about: Public-domain Robert Stuart MacArthur (1841-1923), pastor of Calvary Baptist Church, New York, for the Word Hoard: The Calvary Pulpit, The Attractive Christ, Current Questions for Thinking Men, Bible Difficulties, The Celestial Lamp, Sunday Night Lectures on The Land and the Book, The Old Book and the Old Faith, The Question of the Centuries, Quick Truths in Quaint Texts, Advent, The Christic Reign, Royal Messages, his Lincoln sermon, his life of James B. Simmons, and The Baptists. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 88 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
